**Sybil-Cost Normalisation + Identity** - POV / POC on Redbelly-shaped governance.

> Identity-like UX (Join + link wallets) | Personhood-like unit on-chain | SCN-ready weights later  
> Attestation is a **bridge**, not the destination | Receptor nullifier when Redbelly ships V3

> **Not** the official Redbelly DAO. **Not** affiliated with, operated by, or endorsed by Redbelly Network.

## Credits / attribution

SCNID is **partly based on** [Njaybby/scn-governance](https://github.com/Njaybby/scn-governance) by **[Njaybby](https://github.com/Njaybby)** (MIT - see [`LICENSE.scn-governance`](LICENSE.scn-governance) and [`NOTICE`](NOTICE)).

We keep the SCN person unit, adapter ladder, and related governance ideas; SCNID adds Lab-like Join / link UX, a person-chamber POV on Redbelly testnet, and our own docs. This is an independent adaptation - not an official Njaybby release.

Also draws on shelved Lab eligibility notes in [daoLab](https://github.com/U00A3/daoLab).

## What this is

| Layer | What you get |
|-------|----------------|
| **Join** | CAT / permissioned wallet -> register via primary personhood adapter |
| **Link** | Extra wallets under the same on-chain `person` (Lab UX, SCN unit) |
| **Vote** | Person chamber only in v0 - 1 `person` = 1 on-chain ballot |
| **Officer** | Propose (Live or Hidden tallies), cancel Pending / Active |
| **Adapters** | Mock (default POV) -> Attested (bridge) -> Receptor nullifier (stub) |

No proposal office, no HC review desk, no hybrid off-chain ballots in v0.

## Public demo (hosted UI)

**https://scnid.mynode.uk** - live POV on **Redbelly Network Testnet** (chain `153`).

The **UI source (React, CSS, components) is private** and is not part of this repository. This repo publishes contracts, scripts, tests, and docs. Anyone can still inspect the live page in a browser; we simply do not ship the design sources as an open tree.

| | |
|--|--|
| RPC | `https://governors.testnet.redbelly.network` |
| Explorer | https://redbelly.testnet.routescan.io |
| Bootstrap | `0xDAFEA492D9c6733ae3d56b7Ed1ADB60692c98Bc5` |
| Addresses | `broadcast/testnet-addresses.json` |

### v0 on testnet (current)

| | |
|--|--|
| Person governor | `0x5949F2aD56ee79BB088fb38272bb4004847A721d` (verified on Routescan) |
| Voting window | **30 s** delay, then **24 h** open (`setGovernanceParams`; code defaults are 1 min / 1 h) |
| Hidden | Soft UI seal via description tag; tallies still public on-chain (see `docs/SEALED-VOTING.md`) |
| Cancel | Proposer or owner |
| Stake vault | Deployed address exists; not in the POV UI yet (Phase 3) |
| Primary adapter | Mock personhood (POV Join) |

**Caveat:** vote open/close follow **chain** `block.timestamp`. If testnet blocks stall, the UI may show Pending even after wall-clock time passed the open stamp. See [`docs/TESTNET-NOTES.md`](docs/TESTNET-NOTES.md).

### Deploy contracts (testnet)

Needs a Permissioned deployer + enough testnet RBNT (gas is expensive on 153):

```bash
export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.foundry/bin"
export PRIVATE_KEY=0x...   # must be isAllowed on testnet
forge script script/TestnetDeploy.s.sol:TestnetDeploy --rpc-url redbelly_testnet --broadcast --slow
```

Maintainer-only UI build/deploy stays outside this public tree (private `ui/` checkout + `sync-ui-addresses.sh` + rsync to the host).

## Quick start (Anvil - contracts)

```bash
export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.foundry/bin"
forge test
anvil   # terminal 1
forge script script/LocalDeploy.s.sol:LocalDeploy --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast
./script/demo-scenario.sh
```

Addresses land in `broadcast/` (local file is gitignored; testnet JSON is tracked).

## Layout

```text
contracts/   Foundry sources
script/      Anvil + testnet deploy / demos
test/        forge tests
docs/        overview, sybil, sealed voting, roadmap
broadcast/   testnet-addresses.json (tracked)
ui/          NOT in this repo (private design / frontend)
```

## Status

Lab-style POV on Redbelly testnet (hosted UI). This public repo is contracts + docs. Nothing claimed as production DAO governance. Redbelly does not expose KYC grouping on-chain - we do not promise 1 KYC = 1 vote. Commit-reveal and stake chamber are documented next steps, not shipped.
